newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: FIRST CZECH FLOOD BOND TRANCHE CZK 1 BLN - KLAUS.
newsitem.headline: FIRST CZECH FLOOD BOND TRANCHE CZK 1 BLN - KLAUS.

text.p: The first tranche of crown-denominated Czech domestic bonds, to be issued to help finance flood relief, will be for one billion crowns and will be launched on August 1, Prime Minister Vaclav Klaus said on Wednesday.
Klaus told a news conference the five-year bonds, out of a total of up to five billion, would be available to both retail and institutional investors.
Klaus said on Tuesday that the bonds would have a variable coupon so that net yield, after taxation, would roughly cover inflation.

The bond issue was part of a package of measures launched by the government to help cope with more than a week of severe flooding, whiuch has killed more than 40 people, in the north and east of the country.
The flooding has destroyed or badly damaged huindreds pof homres, interrupted rail and road connections in the affected regions as well as gas, power and telephone links.
Parliament has also approved the release of up to another five billion from privatisation proceeds to help with the relief programme.
The finance ministry is due to release its assessment of the damage on August 13.
